lots.condition: Appears good and sound in the photo; cane intact, likely recaned. Finish wear and joints unseen.
lots.question_for_armitage: Is there any maker brand stamp or paper label (Thonet, J&J Kohn, Mundus, Fischel) under the seat rim or on the leg ring, and is the cane original or a replacement? What is the basis for the Josef Hoffmann attribution?
